# ForgeSpec MCP Protocol 2.0 — Technical Reference

ForgeSpec MCP is a typed MCP server for auditable multi-agent Spec-Driven Development. It uses JSON-RPC over stdio, SQLite with strict tables, JSON1, foreign keys, and WAL, plus Zod validation.

The published package exports `forgespec-mcp/plugin` and both executable bins.
Its shell-free broker lifecycle is start/ready/request/dispose. Root and
enrolled worker handles define the identity threat boundary; no actor fields are
accepted. The identity sidecar has 5 tables, the domain has 16, reset is only
for fresh stores, and OpenCode must be manually restarted after changes.

## Runtime contract

The server qualifies storage before accepting MCP traffic. Startup is fail-closed when storage or capability checks fail. Protocol messages use stdout; diagnostics use stderr. The SDD phases are `init`, `explore`, `proposal`, `spec`, `design`, `tasks`, `apply`, and `verify`.

## Canonical tools (18)

| Family | Tools |
|---|---|
| Attempts | `attempt_claim`, `attempt_recover`, `attempt_renew` |
| Authority | `authority_manage`, `approval_record` |
| Boards and contracts | `board_create`, `contract_commit`, `contract_query`, `contract_validate` |
| Events and health | `event_query`, `forge_health`, `forge_negotiate` |
| Leases | `lease_release`, `lease_renew`, `lease_reserve` |
| Tasks | `task_define`, `task_query`, `task_transition` |

Profiles are `planner`, `worker`, `orchestrator`, and `reviewer`; negotiation returns the deterministic profile subset.

## Storage tables (16)

`fs_schema_meta`, `fs_boards`, `fs_tasks`, `fs_task_dependencies`, `fs_gates`, `fs_gate_decisions`, `fs_attempts`, `fs_contracts`, `fs_leases`, `fs_lease_scopes`, `fs_authority`, `fs_authority_revocations`, `fs_approvals`, `fs_audit_events`, `fs_evidence`, `fs_idempotency`.

## Security and operations

Revisions and scoped idempotency protect mutations. Attempt, authority, and lease tokens are returned once and stored as hashes. Event cursors are opaque HMAC-authenticated values bound to actor and query parameters. `FORGESPEC_CURSOR_SECRET` must contain at least 32 bytes; embedded callers pass `cursorSecret`.

## Usage

```bash
npm ci
npm run build
FORGESPEC_CURSOR_SECRET="at-least-32-bytes-of-secret-material" npx forgespec-mcp
```

`FORGESPEC_DB` selects the SQLite file and `FORGESPEC_DIR` its default directory. The package entrypoint is `build/index.js`.

## Verification

```bash
npm test
npm run lint
npm run build
```
